blocks.text: Suppose point charges q₁, q₂, q₃, ………, qₙ are arbitrarily distributed within an arbitrarily shaped closed surface, as shown in Fig. 9.14. Since φₑ = q/ε₀, so the electric flux passing through the closed surface is:

blocks.alt: An irregular pink closed surface containing seven small orange point charges labelled q1, q2, q3, q4, q5, q6 and qn.
blocks.caption: Figure 9.14 (original drawing after the textbook's Figure 9.14).

blocks.text_alt: φₑ = (1/ε₀) × (Total charge enclosed by closed surface)

blocks.text: where Q = q₁ + q₂ + q₃ + ………… + qₙ, is the total charge enclosed by closed surface. Equation 9.14 is mathematical expression of Gauss's law which can be stated as:

blocks.title: Gauss's law
blocks.text: The total electric flux through any closed surface is 1/ε₀ times the total charge enclosed in it.
